law: If a block exists for the job, use it. Custom CSS for a solved job is a violation.

blocks.name: Answer
blocks.job: Answer option — jewel icon, title + sub, chevron. The choice presented beautifully.
blocks.when_to_use: Quiz/assessment options, any multiple-choice moment. Per-answer --accent.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for binary yes/no (simpler). Not outside assessment context without reason.

blocks.name: Dimension Constellation
blocks.job: 9-dimension orb grid — ring gauge + score + name + status each. The mastery signature.
blocks.when_to_use: Multi-dimensional results: skills radar, assessment breakdown, profile completeness.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for fewer than 4 dimensions (use simpler). The 9-grid is the signature — don't dilute.

blocks.name: Interest Picker
blocks.job: Interest picker — selectable cards with orb + check, selected pills summary.
blocks.when_to_use: Onboarding: 'what are you into?' Preference capture with delight.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for required single-choice. It's a picker, not a quiz.

blocks.name: Progress Hud
blocks.job: Assessment progress — pill bar with location dot, animated fill, percent.
blocks.when_to_use: Top of every multi-step flow: quizzes, onboarding, wizards. Shows 'where am I.'
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for single-step actions. Not as decoration.

blocks.name: Question
blocks.job: Question block — eyebrow label, title, hairline rule. The asking face.
blocks.when_to_use: Every question in an assessment, quiz, or onboarding flow.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for statements. Pair with answer blocks, never alone.

blocks.name: Score Stage
blocks.job: 260px circular score stage — glowing ring with big number. The results hero.
blocks.when_to_use: Assessment results: the final score reveal. The moment of judgment.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for mid-flow scores. One per results page — it's the climax.

blocks.name: Board
blocks.job: Intelligent board container with identity spine — one board, one color, one destination.
blocks.when_to_use: Content sections that deserve a destination feel: feature areas, grouped content. REQUIRED: set --ic identity color.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for single small items (use nl-ccard). Don't nest boards more than one deep.

blocks.name: Board Tone
blocks.job: Board with 5px glowing tone spine — stronger identity edge than board.
blocks.when_to_use: When the board's identity color must read from across the room: category headers, featured sections.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Don't use alongside board in the same view — pick one spine language per page.

blocks.name: Demo Board
blocks.job: Board with 1px light beam across the top edge — for showcasing, demos, specimens.
blocks.when_to_use: Component showcases, demo content, specimen pages. Signals 'this is a demonstration.'
blocks.when_not_to_use: Never for production content — the beam marks it as demo. Never for user data.

blocks.name: Ccard
blocks.job: Content card — the everyday card for content with media.
blocks.when_to_use: Article cards, media cards, generic content tiles. The default when no specialized card fits.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for knowledge content (use intelligent-block). Not for feed items (use activity-card). Not for spaces (use sp-card).

blocks.name: Stage
blocks.job: Elevated demo stage for showcasing components.
blocks.when_to_use: Design system pages, component galleries, before/after comparisons.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not in production UI. It's a workshop table, not furniture.

blocks.name: Cx Btn
blocks.job: Essential CTA — simpler tier, 1.5px border. Clean action without ceremony.
blocks.when_to_use: In-content CTAs, card footers, anywhere a clear action is needed without the full naya-btn weight.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for the primary page action. Not where spectrum theming is needed (use primo).

blocks.name: Icon Btn
blocks.job: 52px round icon button with SVG icons and aria-pressed fill state.
blocks.when_to_use: Icon-only actions: close, menu, favorite, share, settings. Anywhere space is tight and the icon is unambiguous.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Never for actions needing a text label to be understood. Never below 44px touch target (it's 52px for a reason).

blocks.name: Living Btn
blocks.job: Hero flagship button — breathes at idle with a sheen sweep. Maximum presence.
blocks.when_to_use: The ONE hero action on a landing/entrance page. Where you want the button to feel alive before it's touched.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Only one per page. Never in forms or lists. Strip the idle animation if Shawn finds it busy (noted in source).

blocks.name: Lv Btn
blocks.job: The living button — cursor sheen, soul core, proximity-aware. Responds before you click.
blocks.when_to_use: Interactive surfaces where hover feedback matters: dashboards, tool palettes, anywhere the user explores options.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for static pages. The proximity/JS behavior needs lv-btn.js — don't use it as a dumb button.

blocks.name: Naya Btn
blocks.job: The canonical action button — 95% restraint, 5% fire. Use for the single most important action on any surface.
blocks.when_to_use: Primary CTAs: submit, continue, confirm, enter, send. Anywhere the user must take ONE decisive action.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Never for secondary/tertiary actions (use primo or ghost). Never in dense lists where 11 of them would scream.

blocks.name: Btn
blocks.job: Generic elevated button, --tone themable. The utility button.
blocks.when_to_use: Utility actions in dense UI: table rows, list items, toolbars. Theme with --tone to match context.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for hero/primary actions — it has no soul, just function.

blocks.name: Btn Ghost
blocks.job: Ghost button — minimal chrome, text-like action.
blocks.when_to_use: Tertiary actions: cancel, skip, 'learn more', dismiss. Where a full button would be visual noise.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Never for the primary action — ghosts don't convert. Never as the only action (pair with a real button).

blocks.name: Iconbtn
blocks.job: Icon button with liked/saved toggle states.
blocks.when_to_use: Toggle actions on content: like, save, bookmark. The .liked/.saved states show the toggle visibly.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for one-shot actions (use icon-btn). Not where the toggle state doesn't persist.

blocks.name: Playbtn
blocks.job: Play button with ring — for audio/voice playback.
blocks.when_to_use: Voice playback on Intelligent Blocks, audio messages, any 'press to hear' moment. .playing state shows the ring.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for video (use nl-player). Not for navigation.

blocks.name: Orbit Btn
blocks.job: Button ringed by orbiting light — for actions that feel alive, magical, premium.
blocks.when_to_use: Special moments: entering a space, activating a feature, anything where the action itself should feel like an event.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for mundane actions (save, cancel). The orbit draws the eye — spending it on trivia cheapens it.

blocks.name: Primo
blocks.job: The disciplined workhorse button — no idle animation, spectrum theme classes. For everyday actions.
blocks.when_to_use: Secondary actions, repeated actions, form buttons, any action that isn't THE moment. Theme it per context (theme-blue/gold/green/magenta/purple).
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for the hero CTA (use naya-btn or living-btn). Not where you need icon+label complexity.

blocks.name: Space Audio Msg
blocks.job: Audio message with seeded waveform — play button, 24 bars, duration.
blocks.when_to_use: Voice notes in chat. The waveform shows it's audio before it's played.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for music players (use nl-player). Needs --sc accent context.
needs: --sc (space accent — used by .sp-audio-play background/glow and .sp-audio-wave i
the specimen must set it, e.g. --sc:#7c3aed
spAudioMsg sets it on the message box from opts.accent)

blocks.name: Space Chat
blocks.job: Space chat — message list, composer (text + mic + send), post composer.
blocks.when_to_use: Community chat, space conversations, any real-time messaging surface.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for 1:1 DM without adaptation. Needs --sc accent context.

blocks.name: Door
blocks.job: Smart Door card — 'one brain, many doors.' Per-door accent theming, 48px icon.
blocks.when_to_use: Connection points: integrations, entry points to tools/spaces. Grid them.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for content cards (use board/nl-ccard). Doors are passages, not containers.

blocks.name: Drawer
blocks.job: Slide-in drawer — app navigation that tucks away on mobile.
blocks.when_to_use: App side navigation. Toggle via .drawer-open. Mobile-first.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for page nav (use nav). Needs drawer.js for toggle.

blocks.name: Eco Bottombar
blocks.job: Mobile bottom bar — 46px round buttons, jewel plus, pop-up menu. Shared across Hub/Ledger/Spaces.
blocks.when_to_use: Mobile app chrome. The thumb-zone navigation.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Desktop (hidden). Not for page content.

blocks.name: Room Chrome
blocks.job: Room shell — head (kicker+title+lede) + toolbar + body + outlet. Every Hub room composes this.
blocks.when_to_use: App rooms/screens: the consistent frame. --room-accent themes per room.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for marketing pages (use page-shell). This is app interior.

blocks.name: Share Fab
blocks.job: 56px jewel FAB — fixed bottom-right, mobile-only. The action button.
blocks.when_to_use: Mobile primary action: compose, share, create. One per screen.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Desktop (hidden). Never two FABs — one action per screen.

blocks.name: Ledger Day
blocks.job: Day divider for streams — 'Tuesday, October 7' between groups.
blocks.when_to_use: Time-grouped feeds: Ledger stream, activity history. Marks day boundaries.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for non-time groupings. Needs .li-stage wrapper.
states: static label (no hover/animation states in source)

blocks.name: Bar
blocks.job: Bar chart bar — the single bar primitive.
blocks.when_to_use: Building bar charts: repeat per data point, hover reveals knob.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not standalone. For rich bars use jewel-pillar instead.

blocks.name: Chart
blocks.job: Chart container — the frame charts render in.
blocks.when_to_use: Wrapping any chart/graph block with title + sub.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not a chart itself — it's the container. Pair with a graphs/ block for the visual.

blocks.name: Table
blocks.job: Data table with sortable headers — for structured data.
blocks.when_to_use: Tabular data: leaderboards, logs, comparisons. Sortable via th.sorted.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for 2-3 items (use lists). Not on narrow mobile without scroll planning.

blocks.name: State Badge
blocks.job: Inline honesty badge — verified/claimed/demo states made visible. Cheap, everywhere.
blocks.when_to_use: Next to ANY claim: verified (green), claimed (quiet), demo (labeled). The truth-state system in one pill.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Never skip it on claims — that's the whole point. Don't use for decoration.

blocks.name: Swatch
blocks.job: Color swatch — 44px touchable palette bar with hover lift.
blocks.when_to_use: Palettes, theme pickers, design system pages. Showing colors as interactive elements.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not as a color INPUT (no picker logic). Display + selection only.

blocks.name: Truthgrid
blocks.job: Truth-state grid — orb + label + explanation per epistemic state.
blocks.when_to_use: Explaining the honesty system: what verified/claimed/demo/sample mean. Onboarding, docs.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not inline (use state-badge). This is the explainer, not the label.

blocks.name: Activity Card
blocks.job: Feed card — 'every event is a card, not a line.' Jewel, narrative, source + time.
blocks.when_to_use: Activity feeds, timelines, event streams. Each event gets the card treatment.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for knowledge content (use intelligent-block). Not for intel with truth states (use li-card).

blocks.name: Activity Stream
blocks.job: Time-grouped stream — time heads, timeline rows, live dot. The feed container.
blocks.when_to_use: Any chronological feed: activity, history, updates. Renders activity-cards in time groups.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for non-time content. Pair with li-day for day boundaries.

blocks.name: Intel Row
blocks.job: Compact intel row — type tag + title + summary. Dense intelligence list.
blocks.when_to_use: Intel lists, digest rows, anywhere many items need scanning fast.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for hero content. Density is the point — don't use it for 2 items.

blocks.name: Ledger Card
blocks.job: Ledger intel card — identity edge bar, jewel, source, time-ago, hint pill. Truth-aware.
blocks.when_to_use: Intelligence items with provenance: ledger entries, findings, claims with truth states.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for social activity (use activity-card). Needs .li-stage wrapper.

blocks.name: Metric Ribbon
blocks.job: Stat ribbon — auto-fit grid, hairline gaps, honest .unknown states.
blocks.when_to_use: Digest stats, dashboard KPIs, any multi-stat strip. .unknown renders 'not yet' honestly.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for single hero numbers (use living-counter). Not for charts.

blocks.name: Constellation
blocks.job: Network map — glowing nodes, weight-sized, light-arc relationships.
blocks.when_to_use: Relationships: who connects to whom, knowledge graphs, team maps.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for hierarchical data (use lists). Needs real relationship data.

blocks.name: Jewel Pillar
blocks.job: Jeweled series pillars — faceted cap, glowing base, staggered rise.
blocks.when_to_use: Comparing 3-8 values: bar chart, but jeweled. Categories side by side.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for time series (use spectrum-flow). Not for 20+ bars.

blocks.name: Living Counter
blocks.job: The number, alive — count-up numerals, jewel delta, sparkline whisper.
blocks.when_to_use: KPIs, totals, any number that deserves to feel alive on arrival.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for precise tables (use nl-table). The count-up is theater — use it deliberately.

blocks.name: Orbit Dial
blocks.job: Score set in orbit — jewel ring gauge 0-10. The Calculator's face.
blocks.when_to_use: Scores: assessment results, ratings, any 0-10 judgment rendered beautifully.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for non-score numbers. The ring means 'judged' — don't use it for counts.

blocks.name: Pulse Orb
blocks.job: Living orb that breathes with the data — value drives diameter and glow.
blocks.when_to_use: Single hero metrics: the number that matters most, alive.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for comparisons (use jewel-pillar). One metric per orb.

blocks.name: Pulse Rings
blocks.job: Network heartbeat — concentric sonar rings, live total at center.
blocks.when_to_use: Live activity: the pulse of a system right now. Urgency encoded in pace.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for static historical data. It's a heartbeat — it must beat.

blocks.name: Spectrum Flow
blocks.job: Layered spectrum bands — composition of a whole flowing over time.
blocks.when_to_use: Part-to-whole over time: stacked area with soul.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for single series. Not for non-time x-axis.

blocks.name: Field
blocks.job: Text input field with error/ok states and required markers.
blocks.when_to_use: Forms: name, email, any text entry. .err/.ok states for validation feedback.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for search (use nl-search). Not for long text (no textarea variant in library).

blocks.name: Search
blocks.job: Search field — for finding things.
blocks.when_to_use: Global search, list filtering, anywhere the user types to find.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for data entry. Not as a generic text field.

blocks.name: Sn Pill
blocks.job: Smart Note filter pill with popover editor — filter content by note, edit inline.
blocks.when_to_use: Spaces/feed filtering by Smart Note. Where notes are both filters and editable objects.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not as a generic tag (no editor needed). Tied to the Smart Notes concept.
needs: --tc (per-pill accent, set inline by the builder), --cx-dim (dim text color — defined *outside* this block

blocks.name: Gem Bullet
blocks.job: 12px diamond bullet — glowing list marker. Bullets are jewels, never dots.
blocks.when_to_use: List bullets everywhere. Cycle spectrum colors down the list (never repeat adjacent).
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not at sizes other than 12px without care. Not as a status indicator (use mini-orb).

blocks.name: Jw
blocks.job: Jewel atom — reusable across bullets, corners, states. The single jewel primitive.
blocks.when_to_use: Anywhere a jewel is needed inline: law markers, prediction rows, tongue lists, corners.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not as a standalone decorative element at large sizes (use orb).

blocks.name: Intelligent Block
blocks.job: THE signature block — header (jewel+kind+title+truth badge), 4-layer answer, expandable layers, provenance footer.
blocks.when_to_use: Every knowledge surface: answers, explanations, Smart Notes, intelligence delivery. This IS NayaNET's voice in block form.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for feed events (use activity-card). Not for chat. When content has no truth state, you're probably using the wrong block.

blocks.name: Footer
blocks.job: Page footer — brand lockup, link columns, legal row.
blocks.when_to_use: Bottom of every page. The closing statement.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for app bottom bars (use eco-bottombar).
blocks.source: authored 2026-10-09 for the Smart Blocks library (composition layer)

blocks.name: Nav
blocks.job: Top navigation — logo left, links, CTA right. Sticky translucent.
blocks.when_to_use: Every page with navigation. Mobile hamburger included.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for app chrome (use drawer + eco-bottombar). This is page nav.
blocks.source: authored 2026-10-09 for the Smart Blocks library (composition layer)

blocks.name: Page Shell
blocks.job: The page chassis — full-width black ground, no max-width caps, base resets.
blocks.when_to_use: EVERY page starts here. The ground everything else stands on.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Never skip it. Never add max-width caps inside it (Shawn's law).
blocks.source: authored 2026-10-09 for the Smart Blocks library (composition layer)

blocks.name: Portal
blocks.job: Welcome entry portal — orbit rings + purple glow staging a centered core. The front door.
blocks.when_to_use: Entrance/landing pages. The moment of arrival.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not inside apps. Once per experience — it's the door, not a hallway.
needs: orbit keyframes (included where defined in source)

blocks.name: Row Grid
blocks.job: Responsive grids — 2/3/4 col mobile-first, collapsing cleanly.
blocks.when_to_use: Card grids, feature rows, any multi-column layout. Mobile-first always.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for single-column flow (just stack). Not for complex asymmetric layouts.
blocks.source: authored 2026-10-09 for the Smart Blocks library (composition layer)

blocks.name: Section
blocks.job: Content rhythm — vertical spacing with optional jewel divider.
blocks.when_to_use: Between every major content block. The breathing room of the page.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for horizontal layout (use row-grid).
blocks.source: authored 2026-10-09 for the Smart Blocks library (composition layer)

blocks.name: Space About Rows
blocks.job: Key/value about rows — the About-tab card.
blocks.when_to_use: Space/profile about sections: structured facts as rows.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for long prose. Keep values short.
states: about card with rows; optional description paragraph; no accent styling needed (block uses neutral colors)

blocks.name: Space Blockrow
blocks.job: Block list row — title + category label, for picking content.
blocks.when_to_use: Pickers: 'pin an Intelligent Block' lists, content selection.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for display-only lists (use sp-about-rows).
states: hover); list container scrolls (max-height 50vh); optional action button active/inactive (source: Pin / ✓ Pinned)

blocks.name: Player
blocks.job: Media player chrome — for audio/video playback surfaces.
blocks.when_to_use: Podcast/audio players, media embeds. The frame; pair with nl-playbtn for control.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for voice notes in chat (use sp-audio-msg).

blocks.name: Mini Orb
blocks.job: Atomic luminous mark — one class, one variable. The most copy-pasteable element.
blocks.when_to_use: Status dots, list markers, tiny presence indicators. Anywhere you need a 1-element glow.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for hero visuals (use orb). Not as a button (no affordance).

blocks.name: Nav Orb
blocks.job: 40px navigation orb with conic ring — a tappable presence.
blocks.when_to_use: Nav brand marks, user presence in headers, tappable identity.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for body content. Keep it in chrome.

blocks.name: Orb
blocks.job: Sphere of light — the presence of the intelligence made visible.
blocks.when_to_use: Hero moments, loading states with soul, the visual anchor of an entrance or dashboard. Variants: --black, --hero, --btn.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not as decoration scattered everywhere. One orb per view — it's a sun, not confetti.

blocks.name: Ledger Modal
blocks.job: Ledger detail modal — intel deep-dive with stat grid, full a11y plumbing.
blocks.when_to_use: Opening an intel card for the full detail: stats, explanation, provenance. Has focus trap + restore.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not as a generic modal (use nl-modal). Tied to the li- intel grammar.
states: focus restored to invoker on close

blocks.name: Modal
blocks.job: Modal dialog — focused task overlay with backdrop.
blocks.when_to_use: Confirmations, focused forms, detail views that need full attention. Always with a clear dismiss.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for toasts (use nl-toast). Not for bottom sheets on mobile (use nl-sheet). Don't stack modals.

blocks.name: Sheet
blocks.job: Share sheet — bottom sheet for share/actions on mobile.
blocks.when_to_use: Mobile share flows, action sheets. Slides from bottom.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not on desktop (use modal or popover). Not for complex forms.

blocks.name: Toast
blocks.job: Toast notification — transient feedback, auto-dismissing.
blocks.when_to_use: Confirmations ('Saved'), errors, status updates. Fire-and-forget feedback.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for content requiring action (use modal). Not for persistent status.

blocks.name: Checks
blocks.job: Vertical checklist — real checkboxes with accent rows. Verification you can tick.
blocks.when_to_use: Acceptance criteria, verification steps, any 'prove it' list.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for navigation. Each item needs --cc accent.

blocks.name: Law Steps
blocks.job: Law-pipeline steps — jewel marker + rule + explanation. Governance as a staircase.
blocks.when_to_use: Showing process/pipeline stages: how something flows from A to B.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for unordered lists. Steps must have order.
needs: .jewel.mini from the jewels category (or any 1em marker)

blocks.name: Lawcard
blocks.job: Law card — numbered law with diamond marker, title, body. Governance made visible.
blocks.when_to_use: Displaying laws, rules, principles — one card per law.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for procedures (use law-steps). Each card is one law.

blocks.name: Scorecard
blocks.job: Scorecard — dimension label, big glowing number, note. The Calculator's output face.
blocks.when_to_use: Scoring results: dimensions with scores and notes. After assessments.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for single scores (use orbit-dial/score-stage). This is the breakdown.

blocks.name: Tongue
blocks.job: Three-language display — human/AI/machine. The 3-language standard made visible.
blocks.when_to_use: Showing the same truth in three tongues: specs, laws, any trilingual content.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for single-language content. All three tongues must be present.

blocks.name: Verdict
blocks.job: Verdict display — Cormorant voice serif, centered. The judgment, spoken plainly.
blocks.when_to_use: Final judgments, conclusions, the last word on a report/scorecard.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for ongoing content. A verdict closes — don't put body copy after it.

blocks.name: Space Card
blocks.job: Space card with cover art — the grid unit of Spaces discovery.
blocks.when_to_use: Space grids, community discovery. Cover art + name + topic + meta.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for non-space content. Needs --sc accent.

blocks.name: Lens Tabs
blocks.job: Three lens buttons (Collective/Personal/Activity) — the view switcher.
blocks.when_to_use: Hub feed views: switching between collective, personal, and activity lenses. Exactly three, always.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for other tab counts — it's designed for exactly three lenses. Not for navigation.

blocks.name: Seg Tab
blocks.job: Segmented tab — compact option switcher for room controls.
blocks.when_to_use: Small option groups: view modes, filters with 2-5 options. Where space is tight.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for primary navigation (use smart-tabs). Not for many options (scrolls poorly).

blocks.name: Smart Tabs
blocks.job: Feed-navigation tab bar — horizontal scroll, per-tab theming, popover editor. Tabs are navigation intent, never storage.
blocks.when_to_use: Feed filtering, room navigation, any tab set the user can customize (tab-pop editor).
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for 2-3 fixed options (use seg-tab). Not where tabs must never scroll.

blocks.name: Space Dtabs
blocks.job: Underline tabs with count badges — for detail views.
blocks.when_to_use: Space detail, profile sections: tabs with item counts (Members 12, Posts 48).
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for feed filtering (use smart-tabs). Needs --sc accent context.

blocks.name: Switch
blocks.job: Toggle switch — on/off with full a11y states.
blocks.when_to_use: Settings, preferences, feature flags. Any binary choice.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not for multi-option choice (use seg-tab or radio). Not for actions (use buttons).

blocks.name: Toggle Row
blocks.job: Toggle row with label + sub-label — the settings list row.
blocks.when_to_use: Settings screens: each row is a labeled toggle with explanation.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Not standalone (it's a row — needs a list container).

blocks.name: Body
blocks.job: Reading text — 18px floor, 1.65 leading, 68ch measure.
blocks.when_to_use: All body copy. The 18px floor is law.
blocks.when_not_to_use: Never below 18px for reading text. Never gray-on-black low contrast.

blocks.name: Headline
